craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 38. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 12. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: It neither vibrates nor knows nor speaks nor certainly desires; for such a one indeed, all purificatory rites as before should prepare.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na spandate na jānāti na vakti na kilecchati tādṛśasyaiva saṃskārān sarvān prāgvatprakalpayet
